caseName: Lehigh & Hudson River Railway Co. v. Otterstedt
caseNameFull: Lehigh & Hudson River Railway Company v. Florence M. Otterstedt, on Behalf of Herself and Minor Children
attorneys: Mr. John J. Beattie for petitioner., Mr. E. Clarence Aiken for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court, Appellate Division, Third Department, of the State of New York, denied for failure to submit the petition within the time prescribed by the rule.
